name: Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies
summary: Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies are regular deliveries meant for Lieutenant Doren’s camp near the Stranglethorn entrance. They contain land mines to defend against Kurzen and his men.

sections.title: A Needed Delivery
sections.body: Private Thorsen receives the supplies at Lieutenant Doren’s camp, northwest of the road from Duskwood into Stranglethorn Vale. Troll attacks have delayed the regular delivery, and Doren’s followers need it. Thorsen may be at the camp or patrolling south of it. The mines are meant to help defend the camp from Kurzen and his men.

faq.answer: They are land mines provided by the goblins for Lieutenant Doren’s camp.
Private Thorsen receives the supplies for Lieutenant Doren’s followers at their camp.
The camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn Vale from Duskwood.
The mines will help defend Doren’s camp from Kurzen and his men.
